title.zh: Mt. Gox破产受托人经法院批准将债权人还款期限延长一年至2027年10月31日
title.en: 门头沟Mt. Gox将还款期限再次延后一年至2027年10月31日

current_state.zh: Mt. Gox rehabilitation trustee Nobuaki Kobayashi announced that the Tokyo District Court approved extending the creditor repayment deadline by one year to October 31, 2027, as many creditors have yet to complete required procedures or have hit payment processing problems, despite most straightforward claims being largely paid.
current_state.en: Mt. Gox rehabilitation trustee Nobuaki Kobayashi announced that the Tokyo District Court approved extending the creditor repayment deadline by one year to October 31, 2027, as many creditors have yet to complete required procedures or have hit payment processing problems, despite most straightforward claims being largely paid.
